subject: Sales → CS: Novacorp pilot — activation lanes, tech prep, and owner roster
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <ops@novacorp.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <pm@novacorp.com>, legal@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novacorp pilot — next steps and handoff to CS

Elena — thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. As discussed, Novacorp is greenlit for a 60-day pilot (production-like traffic with token-limited quota) focused on clinical document summarization and triage routing. Quick summary of what we committed on the call: 

- Scope: Summarization of clinician notes (max 2k tokens input) + a light reranking step for triage suggestions.
- SLA for pilot: 95th percentile latency target 600ms (expected on dedicated vCPU/GPU pool) and daily quota of 1M tokens.
- Success metrics: avg time-to-summary < 800ms, accuracy vs. baseline (F1) improvement of +12 pts on the sampled eval set.
- Timeline: kickoff week of 2027-07-05; pilot window 60 days from go-live.

Attached are the signed SOW and a preliminary network requirements sheet for your infra team.

For internal handoff: Marissa will be the primary CSM, Mina will be Solutions Engineer for integration, Ben is on escalation duty (hardware/latency). Marissa — can you take point on scheduling kickoff and drafting the mutual action plan? Mina — please review the attached network sheet and call out any blocked ports/KMS items before the kickoff.

Action items for Novacorp before kickoff:
1) Provide service account details and sample (anonymized) notes for end-to-end test.
2) Confirm internal stakeholders for security review (SOC2 evidence request).
3) Approve proposed kickoff times below.

Proposed kickoff slots (PT): 2027-07-06 10:00, 2027-07-07 14:00, 2027-07-08 09:00. Rafa

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <ops@novacorp.com>, Samir Patel <pm@novacorp.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novacorp pilot — next steps and handoff to CS

Thanks Rafael — looping in the team. I’ll lead the kickoff and be Novacorp’s CSM for the pilot. High level internal plan and owners: 

- Marissa Cole (CSM) — overall program lead, stakeholder management, adoption metrics.
- Mina Haddad (Solutions Eng) — integration design, sample data testing, preflight for latency and KV-caching config.
- Ben Carter (Platform Reliability) — escalation contact for perf regressions, capacity planning.

Pre-kickoff checklist (I'll own and track):
• Access: service account + test dataset (anonymized) — Novacorp to send two business days prior.
• Security: request for SOC2 Type II report + any additional attestation — Rafael please confirm if legal needs anything beyond the SOW.
• Network: Mina to validate the network_requirements_sheet.xlsx; any VPN/KMS prerequisites documented.
• Eval set: we'll run a 300-sample eval within the first 72hrs post-integration to validate quality gate.

Mina — I gave the spreadsheet a skim and flagged potential port requirements. Would like you to add a short runbook of the test harness steps and a default quantization/instance config to try for the first run.

Novacorp — the 2027-07-06 10:00 PT slot works for our team; if that’s good on your side we’ll lock it and circulate a calendar invite with agenda and pre-kickoff asks.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager

Thanks — I reviewed network_requirements_sheet.xlsx and sketched a short tech-runbook (attached as inline checklist). Key notes: 
- Port & outbound: allow 443 outbound to api.redwood.prod and 5222 for heartbeat (we can fall back to TLS 443-only if needed).
- KMS: if Novacorp wants to use their own KMS, we need the key ARN and allow our runtime connector IPs.
- KV caching: suggest enabling prefix caching for clinician-note flows to reduce token cost; we'll need a sample of repeated prefixes to tune.

Attached: mina_runbook_preflight.md (inline) + quick perf knobs I recommend for the pilot. Marissa I assigned the preflight checklist items and added estimated hours — total prep estimate ~ 12-16 hrs across infra + integration.

I’ll prepare a minimal quantized model suggestion and a baseline batching config to test during the first run.

Mina

Marissa — thanks for the clear owners. 2027-07-06 10:00 PT is confirmed on our side for kickoff. Couple of asks from ops/legal before the meeting: 

1) SOC2 Type II report — we requested a copy from your legal team; could you confirm the delivery timeline?
2) Test data — we can provide a ~500-record anonymized dump. Will Novacorp need any special hashing/PII redaction or can we ship the sample with pseudonymization?
3) Network — our infra team will review the network sheet tomorrow and loop in our security engineer (I'll share contact details after).

Also, can you include an agenda in the calendar invite with the list of expected outputs from the kickoff (preflight tasks, integration owners, evaluation timeline)? That will help our stakeholders.

Elena
